divergences.design_claim: §5.4/§8/§11: Review-gate fix -> dueCount(now,'puzzle') (plus repertoire if the Review step covers it)
divergences.empirical_reality: Review.svelte covers ONLY kind==='puzzle' (lines 38,44). The session 'review' step routes to Review.svelte. Repertoire is reviewed on its own screen (Repertoire.svelte:96), NOT via the session Review step.
divergences.consequence: The unscoped dueCount(Date.now()) at Session.svelte:67 ALREADY over-counts repertoire today (reserves a Review slot for repertoire-due that the puzzle-only Review step ignores). This is a pre-existing latent bug, independent of vision.
divergences.resolution: Spec narrows the fix to EXCLUDE vision-square only, preserving the existing puzzle+repertoire gate semantics exactly (no repertoire behavior change). Surfaced as arbitrage Q-A (exclude-vision-only vs narrow-to-puzzle).
